sn24.2:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.3: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn24.2:1.5: rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.6: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn24.2:1.10: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.11: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn24.2:2.3: aniccaṃ bhante …pe… api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti. no hetaṃ bhante.
sn24.2:2.9: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.2:2.10: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn24.2:2.12: yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā taṃpi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti.
sn24.2:2.14: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn24.2:2.16: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ apa nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.2:2.17: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn24.2:3.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti …pe… dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti.
sn24.2:3.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
